# BG Wave v1 Canonical Golden Fixtures

These byte-level golden vectors are generated by the canonical C++20
`WaveSignaling` implementation in `bgmedia_core` for cross-repository
interoperability testing with **BeyGram** (JNI / Kotlin).

> **Note:** Wire format v1 is the canonical starting point for E0/E1 alignment.
> Final v1 freeze requires E0 real-SDP peer-connection validation and Telegram
> `text-url` round-trip verification.

## Valid Fixtures

All valid fixtures use `sid = 102132435465768798a9bacbdcedfe0f`, `version = 1`:

| File | Type | Binary Size | `iat` | `exp` | `nonce` | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `offer.bin` / `offer.uri.txt` | `Offer (1)` | 198 B | 1763000000 | 1763000120 | 1 | 3 candidates (IPv4, IPv6, mDNS `.local`), `actpass`, SHA-256 fingerprint |
| `answer.bin` / `answer.uri.txt` | `Answer (2)` | 140 B | 1763000000 | 1763000120 | 2 | 1 `srflx` IPv4 candidate, `active` |
| `cancel.bin` / `cancel.uri.txt` | `Cancel (3)` | 62 B | 1763000010 | 1763000070 | 3 | Empty ICE/DTLS signal |
| `end.bin` / `end.uri.txt` | `End (4)` | 62 B | 1763000090 | 1763000150 | 4 | Empty ICE/DTLS signal |

Each `.uri.txt` contains two lines:
1. `bg://wave/v1/<base64url>`
2. `https://beygram.beykus.fun/#bgwave-v1.<base64url>`

## Negative / Error Fixtures

All `invalid_*.bin` fixtures must fail `decodeWaveSignalBinary()` cleanly without crashing:
- `invalid_bad_magic.bin`: corrupted magic header (`'X'` instead of `'B'`)
- `invalid_unknown_version.bin`: `version = 99`
- `invalid_truncated.bin`: truncated to 12 bytes
- `invalid_trailing_bytes.bin`: valid `offer.bin` with 1 trailing byte (`0xAA`)
- `invalid_zero_sid.bin`: valid `offer.bin` with all-zero 16-byte `sid`

## Sanitized WebRTC SDP Fixture

- `sanitized_webrtc_offer.sdp`: realistic sanitized WebRTC audio SDP (`a=mid:0`, `a=ice-options:trickle`, `a=rtcp-mux`, `a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2`, `raddr`/`rport`/`generation 0`, IPv4 + IPv6 + mDNS `.local`). Note that `WaveSdpSignal` represents a compact ICE/DTLS subset and does **not** claim full general SDP equivalence prior to E0 live peer-connection testing.
